en.headline: Lam says Justice Bureau will study who pays if AI causes harm
en.dek: The secretary for justice told LegCo a task force will look at liability when an AI product causes damage, alongside guidance for minors.
body: Secretary for Justice Paul Lam Ting-kwok said on Thursday that the Department of Justice will lead a task force to study who is legally responsible if a product that uses artificial intelligence causes harm.

Speaking on the second day of the Legislative Council's joint debate on the first five-year plan and the Policy Address, Lam said lawmakers had raised the question of who answers when AI goes wrong. He said the bureau would set up the group and look into the issue as soon as possible.

Lam also responded to a suggestion that, before any review of AI regulation is finished, the government could issue guidance keyed to a minor's age and encourage young people to protect themselves. He said the law is one option, and education is equally important. Guidance or handbooks aimed at minors, and at teachers and parents, would be more flexible, he said.

In the same debate, Secretary for Innovation, Technology and Industry Sun Dong said the government is pushing an AI-plus programme under the five-year plan. He said the first phase of the Sandy Ridge data park site could start operating as early as the middle of next year, and that the government will inject 1 billion dollars into an AI funding scheme to support frontier work. He added that the Digital Policy Office will appoint an AI commissioner to help carry out the risk-governance strategy in the Policy Address, and will issue safety guidance on AI agents with Hong Kong's artificial intelligence research institute.

zh.headline: 林定國：律政司將研究人工智能產品造成損害的法律責任
zh.dek: 律政司司長在立法會表示，會牽頭成立專責小組，並指針對未成年人的指引同樣重要。
body: 律政司司長林定國周四在立法會說，律政司會牽頭成立專責小組，盡快研究使用人工智能產品一旦造成損害，法律責任應如何界定。
立法會第二天合併辯論香港首個五年規劃及施政報告。林定國說，有議員提出「人工智能出錯誰來負責」。他表示，專責小組會盡快研究這個問題。
他又回應有議員建議，在完成檢討人工智能相關管制之前，可按未成年人的年齡發出指引，並引導他們自我保護。林定國說，法律是其中一個選項，教育同樣重要；針對未成年人、老師和家長的指引或手冊，會較有彈性和靈活性。
同場的創新科技及工業局局長孫東說，政府正按五年規劃推進「人工智能+」。他表示，沙嶺數據園區一期用地最快可於明年年中投入首階段運作，政府亦會向人工智能資助計劃注資10億元，支援前沿研究。他又說，數字政策辦公室會設立人工智能專員，協助推展施政報告中的風險治理策略，並會與香港人工智能研發院發布人工智能體的安全管理指引。
